pain: Accepted Activity Events need durable, atomic, append-only storage that survives object eviction and restart and keeps Duplicate and Conflict outcomes.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: All storage SQL lives in src/ledger-object.ts, class EventLedgerObject, and no other module calls ctx.storage.

The constructor applies the plan.md schema inside blockConcurrencyWhile with CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS, including STRICT tables, UNIQUE event_key and correction_id, and triggers that abort UPDATE and DELETE on entries, and a test proves each refuses a bad write.
Lookup, Duplicate or Conflict decision, head read, digest and insert run inside one synchronous ctx.storage.transactionSync callback that awaits nothing, and every non-append outcome writes nothing.

openEventLedger(namespace) addresses idFromName("event-ledger"), exposes appendActivityEvent, appendCorrection, readHistory and head as async methods, and wraps errors thrown over RPC in EventLedgerStorageError.

readHistory pages with fromSequence up to a throughSequence fixed at the first call, at most 1000 entries and 16 MiB of entry_json per page, and a test reads a multi-page history equal to a single verified prefix.

A test mutates the caller object after append and readHistory returns the committed payload; another appends an earlier occurredAt after a later one and both instants come back byte-for-byte in append order.

A reopen test uses evictDurableObject and abortAllDurableObjects and shows the same entries and digest chain, a repeated append returning duplicate with the original receipt, and a changed append returning conflict.

out_of_scope: Live Collectors and Identity Binding config
Projections, Activity Calendar and Project Timeline
Any HOME API, route, MCP server or Scope enforcement
Real customer or account data; fixtures are synthetic
Cloudflare deploys, wrangler login and creating any Cloudflare resource
Merges and paid model spend without Danny's yes
